content.title: The 4 Signs Most Impacted by April's New Moon in Aries
content.text: The new moon in Aries is part of a major astrological moment. The new moon, which occurs on April 17 at 7:52 a.m. ET, is part of an Aries stellium, meaning three or more planets in the same sign.The moon, Mercury, Mars, Saturn and Neptune will all be in the fire sign Aries on April 17, possibly making us feel stuck or even irritable.This new moon can be thought of the spark igniting our passions. First, it falls in the pioneering fire sign Aries, considered the initiator of the zodiac. The centaur Chiron and asteroid Eris connect with the new moon, offering us the opportunity to learn from the past and to explore future possibilities with vigor. Then, generally speaking, new moons are always considered a time for kicking off plans and dreams. Below, find the four signs that will be impacted the most by the energy.Aries TODAY Illustration / Getty ImagesThe new moon is a wonderful time to take leaps and bounds in healing your subconscious. Healing asteroid Chiron, which is currently in Aries (Chiron is a smaller celestial body that is classified as a centaur because of its erratic orbit and an asteroid because of its mass), will be in aspect with your sun. You will want to take action to address our deepest wounds and mend relationships. During this time, you’ll be able to take a deep look at our recent hurts and see how you can change your perspective on them. Issues with confidence and self-esteem will come to the forefront. Look within to make a change. Give yourself an emotional lift by implementing self-care into your routine today to feel better.Cancer TODAY Illustration / Getty ImagesThe ups and downs in your professional life offer you a new perspective on your career. If you find yourself feeling alienated, reach out to one of your nearest and dearest for a little pep talk. People around you might seem a little aggressive later in the afternoon, and you yourself are likely to feel a bit on edge. Remember to focus on your breath and ground yourself if you're moving into a negative or overly irritable headspace. Luckily, any tensions from the day will all seem like water under the bridge. These vibes are perfect for making amends, so if you did butt heads with someone earlier, now would be the time to smooth things over. Be sure to pamper yourself and fully destress after a semi-hectic day. Libra TODAY Illustration / Getty ImagesWhen the stellium affects your seventh house of partnerships, you may want to reconnect with old friends and meet new ones. This aspect can also increase the rate of conflicts. You may get lost in the waves of love and emotion. Be careful about trusting those who don’t deserve it, and make sure you’re in tune with your crew. Just remember the importance of setting boundaries and taking a time out when you need to. As the new moon comes to a close, you may feel slightly energized, even with all of the dramatic energy hanging about, so be sure to give yourself plenty of time to wind down.Capricorn TODAY Illustration / Getty ImagesThe serendipitous aspects will yield positive energy. Your mind will look for ways to expand during this time, but don’t get frustrated if the outside world struggles to catch up. Toward the end of the day, your focus will shift to how you’ve evolved. This big-picture energy might feel heavy, but as long as you can release the things that are holding you back, you will come out of this lunation on top. You may also find yourself in a creative or expressive funk during the first part of the day. You’ll be in the mood to put yourself out there, but you might not always receive the validation you’re seeking.
